purpose: Teach: 非合法/謀略/疎外/破裂/充満/退学/単発/創世

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、非合法な薬の流通を医療チームで警戒します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team actively monitors illegal drug distribution in hospital supply chains.
lines.style: Direct, professional opening. Measured cadence. No inflection—just clear statement of fact. Eyes level. Clinical but not cold.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療スキャンダルにおける謀略を医療チームで防止します
lines.en: Yes, we work as a team to prevent conspiracy and misconduct in medical scandals.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring continuation. Slight weight on 'we'—including him in the accountability. Unhurried. The voice of someone who has thought about this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 社会的に疎外された患者さんへの配慮を、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: I see. Your hospital really does take care of patients who are socially marginalized, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Careful phrasing—not quite a question, more like genuine recognition dawning. Respectful pause before 'Doctor.' Genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、血管が破裂した患者の救命を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, our team handles emergency response for patients with life-threatening vascular complications.
lines.style: Same steady register as before. Factual, without emphasis. The answer of someone accustomed to answering questions about her work. Professional distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 煙が充満した火災後の救護を、貴院、なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital was involved in rescue operations after that fire with heavy smoke, wasn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet admiration in the question. Not fishing—genuinely piecing together what this hospital does. Thoughtful delivery. Slight lean-in of attention.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医師退学者の再教育を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we also oversee retraining and reintegration for medical professionals who've left the field.
lines.style: Same steady tempo. A note of quiet pride on 'reintegration'—this matters to her. Not boastful. Just honest about scope of care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 単発の症例研究を、貴院、ご発表されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital published original case studies as well, then, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity without pushiness. Building a picture of her, not testing her. Soft, open-ended. The voice of someone listening and learning.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、生命創世に関する医学倫理を医療チームで議論します
lines.en: Yes, our team engages in ongoing discussions about medical ethics surrounding life and creation.
lines.style: Slightly quieter than before—these are weightier words. Deliberate, careful pacing. The voice of someone speaking about something that matters deeply. Close, intimate, not distant.
